lessons: Follow specified validation order and error precedence: finish higher-priority scans before semantic checks or dependent processing.
Validate the complete input structure, including empty fields and bounds, before parsing or mutating state.
Prove progress and termination for every iterative step; each step must advance, complete, or reach a valid terminal state.
Track source positions and full spans during traversal so errors and boundaries refer to the exact triggering input.
Preserve invariants throughout an operation; check capacity, allocation sizes, arithmetic, and conversions before mutation or reservation.
Match serialized tokens and punctuation exactly to the specified grammar.
Use interval boundaries, adjacency, and destination-aware distance data to prove existence and reconstruct shortest routes; finite samples are insufficient.

lessons: Validate the complete input structure and grammar before interpreting values or returning errors; honor specified global validation precedence.
Validate inputs before arithmetic, and prove every intermediate fits across all accepted execution paths; use checked operations when needed.
Check every explicit interface, file, and source constraint, including required omissions and forbidden constructs, before submitting.
Implement each algorithm’s complete selection and tie-breaking rule at every step.
After each event that makes a resource available, process all eligible queued work before advancing time; preserve cumulative budgets across interruptions and requeues.
Preserve explicit dimensions and represent control state separately from valid data values.
When serializing collections, emit delimiters only between actual elements.
Detect numeric overflow during digit accumulation instead of relying on a wider type to hold an unbounded token.

lessons: Validate caller-controlled sizes and bound resource use before allocating or doing work; keep extreme-input error paths safe.
Apply every specified validation rule consistently across all operations that accept the same input, before lookup or mutation.
Honor validation precedence across all inputs: check error categories in the specified order before returning an error.
Track original byte ranges through parsing and transformation; report errors at the byte that caused them, without normalizing before validation.
Check every consumed byte in the required order before changing parser state, and define safe error paths for all valid input lengths.
Preserve causal state before mutating related items, then derive outputs from that snapshot; exclude replaced state consistently from feasibility checks and accounting.
Compute finalized canonical paths before deriving provenance, and compare complete candidate paths when resolving lexicographic ties.
Translate ordering rules into explicit boundary cases, and reason about ordered-domain intervals and successors rather than sampling representative values.
